qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: Post-graduate degree (BS-MS, MSc, M.Tech) in Atmospheric Sciences, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, Civil/Environmental/Chemical Engineering. National-level examination such as NET/CSIR-JRF/UGC-JRF/GATE is mandatory. Hands-on experience with chromatography, spectroscopy, or X-Ray Fluorescence is required. Lab Assistant: B.Sc. in Atmospheric Science, Environmental Science/Studies, Chemistry, Physics or other Science disciplines with a minimum of 60% marks.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IISER Bhopal to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IISER Bhopal Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IISER Bhopal Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 2 for Junior Research Fellow and 1 for Lab Assistant.

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Post-graduate degree (BS-MS, MSc, M.Tech) in Atmospheric Sciences, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, Civil/Environmental/Chemical Engineering. National-level examination such as NET/CSIR-JRF/UGC-JRF/GATE is mandatory. Hands-on experience with chromatography, spectroscopy, or X-Ray Fluorescence is required. Lab Assistant: B.Sc. in Atmospheric Science, Environmental Science/Studies, Chemistry, Physics or other Science disciplines with a minimum of 60% marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IISER Bhopal to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Junior Research Fellow and Lab Assistant posts is 17th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow and Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies, with 2 positions for Junior Research Fellow and 1 position for Lab Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: A Post-graduate degree (BS-MS, MSc, M.Tech) in relevant fields like Atmospheric Sciences, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, or Civil/Environmental/Chemical Engineering is required, along with a national-level exam qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Lab Assistant will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IISER Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the official IISER Bhopal website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Application Screening stage.

faq.question: Q8. What is the expected joining date after selection?
faq.answer: The expected joining date for the selected candidates is 01st October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Does IISER Bhopal offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
